subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “'Words are useful,' she said, 'but they are not the only way to speak.'”?
options: But it taught students that city planning is often about balancing needs, not choosing between good and bad.
At night, even familiar things can make people ask new questions.
The night taught students to watch more carefully, not only listen.
Clean energy became less abstract when students could watch it being made above their own classrooms.
